title: Pig-tailed macaque
content: The pig-tailed macaques are two macaque sister species. They appear similar and are best distinguished by their parapatric ranges:Northern pig-tailed macaque, inhabiting Bangladesh to Vietnam, south to northern Malaysia Southern pig-tailed macaque, also called beruk, inhabiting Northern Malaysia and southern Thailand to Borneo and western Indonesia
